highlights.title: Debloated System
highlights.summary: Cleaned up legacy AOSP stubs, Abstruct wallpaper bloat, and redundant background services for improved battery and memory efficiency.

highlights.title: OnePlus Camera & Gallery
highlights.summary: Integrated stock OPlus Camera with 10-bit color, portrait ArcSoft licenses, fixed video recording & motion photo capture, and OnePlus Gallery with Live Photos support.

highlights.title: Modern Dual SIM Signal Icons
highlights.summary: Restyled status bar signal indicators for dual SIM setups into a clean, modern compact layout alongside active Wi-Fi generation badges.

highlights.title: Camera Sensor Readiness & Stability
highlights.summary: Restored hardware sensor-mode readiness synchronization to eliminate capture drops during photo transitions.
